image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ situated on a balcony within a Gothic-style cathedral. The organ features multiple vertical pipe arrays of varying heights and diameters, arranged in symmetrical clusters with decorative casework. The pipes appear to be made of polished metal (silver/tin) and wood. The background shows intricate stone vaulted ceilings and architectural details typical of a historic church.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a visible gradient in pipe height, with tall central pipes and shorter surrounding pipes, creating the characteristic stepped profile of a large pipe organ.

To check for fusion artifacts between adjacent pipes and ensure each pipe is a distinct, continuous cylindrical entity without boundary bleeding.
To assess the realism of lighting, reflections on metal surfaces, and texture consistency of the stone architecture.
